captions_note: the effect draws no words, the reel's captions run over it
in_a_reel: ON is the first word of the line that gets the look. Start the slot at least 0.1 s before it
BACK = 'auto' cuts back just before the slot ends. BACK = None only when the slot ends on a cut of the reel
steps: edit ON in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1      # bakes the look, prints the times
run check.py      # frame count, plain first frame, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
